names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 7 august, «Sfânta Irina, Împărăteasa», with the rank word left off; her own page heads her «Sfânta Irina – Împărăteasa icoanelor».

floruit.note: The council her own life.md credits her with: «Her great merit, the page says, was the convoking of the Seventh Ecumenical Council, which met at Nicaea in Asia Minor in 787». The page gives her no year of birth or death.

office: Empress of the Romans, regent for her son Constantine VI

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 7 august — «Sfânta Irina, Împărăteasa»

attestations.note: Her page repeats the day: «Prăznuită de către Biserică în ziua de 7 august». It gives her no years; the only date in it is 787, the year of the council she called.
